title: When the Regiment Sings
author: Freya Sterling
blurb: Wren Thornbury, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
